Given [] or a rectangular grid of 0 and 1 with nonempty rows, count connected groups of 1 using horizontal and vertical adjacency. Do not modify the grid.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

  "args": [
    [
      [
        1,
        0,
        1
      ],
      [
        1,
        0,
        0
      ],
      [
        0,
        1,
        1
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 3
}

      ]
    ]

  "expected": 2
}

Flood-fill each newly discovered land cell.
